name: saygoal
description: The /dec and /repo-audit slash commands — declarative reframing of a request into a /goal contract — success criteria + verification + non-goals — plus a read-only repo audit emitting /goal-ready tasks. Pair with Claude Code's built-in /goal (v2.1.139+). Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) localization fork of forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills.
